intro: Over five articles published between April 26 and July 17, 2026, ZCyberNews has tracked high-severity threats under the southeast-asia tag. Chinese Transnational Organized Crime, CL-STA-1062, and GoSerpent were among the threat actors observed. The coverage highlighted CVE-2026-3502, a vulnerability with a CVSS score of 7.8. Affected sectors included government, diplomatic, energy, financial services, and telecommunications, while targeted regions spanned Southeast Asia, Cambodia, Europe, and the United States.
